corrections.critique: Strongest feature: Malpass challenges the explanatory coherence of a timeless personal creator, invoking acquaintance with dynamic consciousness and dreamless sleep as a discriminating contrast, while responsibly presenting plausibility rather than conclusive disproof. Principal limitation: Temporal experience cannot establish that every possible consciousness changes, leaving underexamined atemporal awareness and unspecified which phenomenal, intentional, or agential characteristic logically requires succession. Live burden: The creator theorist must explain how changeless disembodied awareness remains recognizably conscious and capable of personal agency, while Malpass must justify generalizing contingent phenomenology into a modal constraint on mentality. Locked score: The very strong 85 appropriately reflects decisive relevance, explicit qualification, and charity, tempered by defeasible introspection and partly unstable analysis of dynamism and changelessness.
